listing.description:
A 2027 digital planner built for small business owners. Track goals, revenue, expenses, clients, projects and content, then plan every week and day. Fully hyperlinked.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Linked contents page and 2027 year at a glance
- Business goals
- Revenue tracker and expense tracker (12 months)
- Client list
- 4 project planners
- Content ideas tracker
- 12 monthly calendars with focus and launches
- 53 weekly spreads: top 3 goals, content to post, follow ups
- 365 dated daily pages: top 3 goals, calls and emails, revenue today, hourly schedule
- 10 notes pages

FEATURES
- Month tabs on every page
- Every date links to its daily page
- Navy and gold, professional look
- 450+ pages in one PDF

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download the PDF from your Etsy account (Purchases and reviews).
2. Import it into Goodnotes, Notability, Xodo, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes or any PDF app that supports links.
3. Write with your stylus. Use read mode (in Goodnotes, turn the pen off) to tap tabs and dates.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped.
- Landscape 4:3 PDF, best on iPad and Android tablets.
- For personal use only. Please don't share or resell the file.

Designed by our shop with the help of AI tools for layout and writing. Every page is checked by us.
Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.
